tagline: 理光胶片相机，1983 年发布
description: 理光于1983年推出的胶片相机。快门速度Electronically controlled. 16sec - 1/1000sec +B.。使用35mm film, 24x36mm.。感光度ASA 12-3200。Split-image spot in microprism band。

specs.曝光测光: TTL full open metering for center-weighted average light reading coupled automatically to f-stop.
specs.电池: Two LR-44 Alkaline batteries or two SR-44 Silver Oxide batteries.
specs.英文简介: The KR-10 Super was introduced by Ricoh in 1983, as a significant revision to the previous KR-10 (without suffix).
